children: Chile’s copper production fell 9.4% year-on-year to 403,424 metric tons in July 2026, reversing a 5.1% increase in June.
The decline was attributed to unfavorable weather conditions in northern Chile that disrupted production, as well as maintenance work at major mining operations.
The sharp drop in output from Chile, the world’s largest copper producer, added to concerns over tightening global copper supplies.

title: Chile Copper Output Drops in July
